test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "prioritise" fits well in this contex**t as it conveys the action of giving more importance or precedence to mental and physical health.
 
• **"Prioritise our mental and physical health"** aligns with the intent of the passage to emphasize the importance of well-being.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

**Correct Sentence:** ***"In today’s fast-paced and technology-driven world, it is crucial to disconnect occasionally for the sake of our health. Constant exposure to screens and the demands of the digital era can lead to stress, anxiety, and reduced well-being. Taking time to unplug and engage in activities that promote relaxation, such as spending time in nature, pursuing hobbies, or simply enjoying quality time with loved ones allows us to recharge, find balance, and prioritise__ our mental and physical health."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "precede"** – This is incorrect because "precede" means to come before something, which does not fit the context of emphasizing health.
 
• **Option 2: "underscore"** – This is incorrect because "underscore" means to emphasize, which is similar to the intended meaning but does not quite fit in this context as naturally as "prioritise."
 
• **Option 3: "focus"** – This is incorrect because "focus" can imply paying attention to, but it misses the nuance of giving priority to health over other aspects.
